## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

widgets_values: Ultra-realistic candid cinematic fullbody shot of the terrifying black skin alien sucubus, incredibly sex and alluring, suddenly caught during a daytime encounter. Dimly lit, crumbling ancient Greek temple with harsh shafts of sunlight breaking through the ceiling. The camera frames her entire form standing amidst stone debris: a powerful, athletic female torso with realistic skin texture, sweat, and veins, topped by a head where a writhing mass of venomous, scaled green serpents replaces her hair, extending down to her bare feet on the cracked temple floor. The snakes are coiling and hissing, while Medusa looks directly at the camera with piercing, calcifying eyes. Photographic artifacts: high ISO digital noise, slight motion blur on the striking snakes, realistic depth of field (sharp on her full figure, softer background), minor camera shake. Cool flash color cast, raw aesthetic, ultra-detailed textures, National Geographic cryptid style, grain.
high quality, sharp focus, fine detail, clean
